profile.Name: Cat
profile.Job: Medic, prisoner of the Dust King
profile.Personality: Chatty, excitable, and a little unhinged. He fires off silly questions, calls a fly named Chubbs his only friend, and gushes over anyone who frees him.
profile.Backstory: A United Cities citizen who put on his best clothes to meet a girl from out of town he had courted by letter. Dust Bandits took him for a rich merchant and held him for ransom, but no one paid, so he has spent seasons locked in the Dust King's tower.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Rambles fast and piles on random questions, such as 'Do you have an outtie or an innie?' Talks to Chubbs the fly when no one else will listen.
